title: Abdali Marches to Delhi and a New Sikh Challenge Opens

blocks.text: The page closes the previous emotional thread quickly and opens a wider military horizon. Ahmed Shah after occupation of Lahore proceeded on an expedition towards Delhi, leaving part of his force behind and creating a fresh field of conflict around the remaining Afghan presence.

Those troops move against a Sikh village and force a local band across the river, but the gesture only invites a sharper confrontation. Rather than ending Sikh resistance, imperial occupation multiplies occasions for challenge and reply.

By the close of the page a taunting epistle has been sent to the Singhs. The narrative is therefore poised for formal exchange, with honor, insult, and public testing once again driving the next sequence.
